label: Bus
description: Asynchronous application event bus using MessageChannel. Listeners receive event envelopes containing type, ts, and detail.

addEventListener.description: Registers a listener for an event name. Use '*' to receive all dispatched events. Listeners receive an event envelope { type, ts, detail }.

parameters.name: listener
parameters.description: Callback invoked asynchronously with { type, ts, detail }.

removeEventListener.description: Removes matching listener registrations for the specified event name.

emit.description: Posts an event through MessageChannel for asynchronous delivery to named listeners and '*' listeners. The payload must be structured-cloneable.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Event name, stored in the dispatched envelope's type field.

parameters.name: detail
parameters.description: Optional event payload, stored in the dispatched envelope's detail field.
